description: Canonical RateLimitError (429) corpus. HTTP 429 surfaces as the SDK's RateLimitError carrying the Retry-After value parsed from the response header (seconds or HTTP-date). The SDK retries idempotent GETs on 429 honoring Retry-After; mutations are NOT retried (the 429 is surfaced immediately). The seeded e2e runs with MOSS_DISABLE_RATE_LIMIT=1 so 429 cases are typically mock-driven.

cases.name: capability_quota_exceeded
cases.message: The customer's capability_tokens_per_hour quota has been exceeded.
cases.trigger: capabilities.issue over the customer's capability_tokens_per_hour quota.
cases.parity_note: The SDK does NOT auto-retry a 429 for this mutation (mutations are not retried). Exactly one backend POST was made.

cases.name: partner_rate_limited
cases.message: The partner has exceeded the rate-limit window.
cases.trigger: A burst of mint/list calls beyond the partner window.
cases.parity_note: Assert only 429 + Retry-After presence per the known partner-429 header cosmetics. The header value may be present even if its semantic content is approximate.

cases.name: webhooks_per_customer_exceeded
cases.message: The customer's webhooks-per-customer limit has been reached.
cases.trigger: webhooks.register beyond the customer's webhooks limit.
cases.parity_note: This is a hard cap, not a time-windowed quota; Retry-After may be absent. The SDK still surfaces RateLimitError with status 429.

sdk_mapping.retry_policy: GET retried honoring Retry-After; mutations NOT retried (surfaced immediately).
